name: image-editor
description: Image search, generation, editing, layered PSD export, background removal, creative poster direction, and safe-zone review.

interface.shortDescription: Image creation, art direction, editing, and poster validation
interface.longDescription: Select objects and remove backgrounds locally, find source-attributed web images, generate or edit through supported AI providers, export canonical projects as layered PSD files, develop divergent poster concepts, select a brand-ownable art direction, create coherent posters and carousels, validate safe zones, and finish reproducibly with immutable assets and project revisions.
defaultPrompt: Search the web for current, source-attributed image references.
Generate a professional image and preserve its provenance.
Edit this image conversationally without overwriting the source.
Remove this image background locally without uploading it.
Decompose this design into editable semantic layers.
Export this canonical image project as a layered PSD file.
Develop divergent visual concepts, select a strong art direction, and create a brand-compliant poster or carousel with controlled variation and exact safe-zone validation.
Check this poster's critical content against its safe zone before export.
